title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid credentials and mandatory information.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page
Input valid user details including email, password, and profile info
Submit the registration form
Check that registration is successful and redirects user to login or onboarding

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Check that users can log in successfully with valid username/email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid username/email and password
Click the login button
Confirm successful login and landing on the dashboard

title: User Login with Multi-Factor Authentication Enabled
description: Validate login flow when MFA is enabled, ensuring MFA challenge is presented and validated.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid credentials for user with MFA enabled
Submit login
Verify that MFA prompt is shown
Enter correct MFA code
Check user is successfully logged in after MFA verification

title: User Login Fails with Incorrect Password
description: Ensure that login attempts with invalid password display appropriate error without granting access.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter valid username/email with incorrect password
Attempt to login
Confirm error message is displayed and login is denied

title: Demo Mode Access Without Credentials
description: Verify that users can access the demo mode and explore features without real credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the landing page
Select the demo mode option
Verify access to demo environment is granted with demo profiles loaded

title: Discover Profiles and Like Functionality
description: Confirm user can browse profiles and successfully like profiles in the discover module.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the Discover screen
Browse through available profiles
Select a profile and perform a like action
Verify the like action is acknowledged with UI feedback and recorded

title: Match Generation and Visibility in Matches Screen
description: Validate that when two users like each other, a match is created and visible in Matches screen.

steps.description: User A likes User B's profile
User B likes User A's profile
Navigate to Matches screen
Confirm the matched profile appears in the user's Matches list

title: Real-Time Chat Between Matched Users
description: Check that matched users can send and receive real-time messages in the chat interface.

steps.description: Login as matched User A and open chat with User B
Send a text message to User B
Verify User B receives the message instantly
Login as User B and send a reply message
Confirm User A receives the reply in real-time

title: Private Gallery Access Denied Without Token Payment
description: Ensure private galleries are blurred and access is denied unless token payment is made.

steps.description: Open chat with matched user who has a private gallery
Confirm private gallery is displayed blurred and access is locked
Attempt to view private gallery without token payment
Verify access is denied and prompt for token payment is shown

title: Unlock Private Gallery Via Token Payment
description: Validate that users can unlock private galleries by paying with CMPX tokens successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to a matched user's private gallery
Initiate token payment to unlock gallery
Confirm token balance is correctly deducted
Verify private gallery unlocks and contents are visible

title: Token Wallet Dashboard Displays Correct Balances
description: Check that user's token dashboard displays correct CMPX and GTK token balances and transaction history.

steps.description: Login and navigate to Token Wallet dashboard
Verify CMPX and GTK token balances are accurate and up to date
Validate transaction history is correctly displayed and scrollable

title: Profile Editing for Single Profile
description: Ensure users can edit their single profiles and updates are saved correctly.

steps.description: Login and navigate to single profile edit screen
Modify profile fields including name, description, and preferences
Save changes
Verify profile data is updated and persists upon reload

title: Role-Based Access Control for Admin Routes
description: Verify that admin and moderation pages are only accessible by users with appropriate roles.

steps.description: Login as regular user and attempt to access /admin route
Confirm access is denied with appropriate message or redirect
Login as admin user and access /admin route
Verify admin dashboard and moderation tools load correctly

title: Responsive Navigation Menus On Different Devices
description: Test that navigation menus render correctly and are fully functional on mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.

steps.description: Access app on desktop viewport
Verify top navigation menu layout and interactivity
Resize to tablet viewport and reload
Ensure navigation adapts responsively and remains usable
Access app on mobile viewport
Check bottom navigation menu is visible and functional

title: AI Help Center Accessibility and Functionality
description: Validate that the AI Help Center screen is accessible from the app and provides functioning assistance features.

steps.description: Login and navigate to AI Help Center page
Confirm AI help interface loads with expected UI components
Use AI assistance features such as submitting a query
Verify AI responds appropriately and timely

title: Marketplace and NFTs Screens Load Correctly
description: Confirm the marketplace, shop, and NFTs pages render and display relevant content to users.

steps.description: Navigate to the Marketplace page
Verify marketplace listings are displayed with images and details
Access the NFTs page
Confirm NFTs are shown properly with relevant metadata
Visit the Shop page
Check premium shop products are listed and navigable

title: Parental Controls Enforce Access Restrictions on Private Galleries
description: Test that parental controls are effectively restricting access to private galleries as per settings.

steps.description: Login as user with parental controls enabled
Attempt to access a private gallery
Confirm access is blocked and parental controls warning is displayed

title: Loading Legal and Compliance Pages Correctly
description: Verify all legal, privacy, Ley Olimpia, and related info pages render and content is readable.

steps.description: Navigate to the Legal hub page
Confirm the page content loads without broken elements
Visit Privacy Policy page
Verify privacy text is displayed and scrollable
Access Ley Olimpia compliance page
Check for presence of compliance statements and readability

title: Secure Routing Prevents Unauthorized Access
description: Ensure protected routes redirect unauthorized users to login or show access denied messages.

steps.description: Attempt to access a protected route without authentication
Verify user is redirected to login or access denied page
Login as normal user and attempt to access admin route
Confirm access is denied or redirected from admin routes

title: Automated Tests Coverage Verification
description: Confirm that all critical flows (authentication, discover-match-chat, tokens, navigation) have automated unit, integration, and E2E test coverage documented and executable.

steps.description: Run unit tests from src/tests/unit folder
All tests pass with coverage report generated
Run integration tests in src/tests/integration
Verify test suite passes with expected coverage
Execute E2E tests from src/tests/e2e
Confirm critical user flows execute successfully without failures
